scope: Task-owned macOS diagnostic app and disposable APFS clones; no installed-app launch or production code change

historical_crash.launch_modification: Main CFBundleIdentifier and CFBundleName changed; helper app names and identifiers unchanged
historical_crash.correlation: The retained launch output and attached crash report match on diagnostic process, time, and SIGTRAP; no symbolicated instruction-offset match was established

controlled_renderer_probe.method: APFS-cloned private package, minimal hidden BrowserWindow loading local data HTML, did-finish-load marker, private HOME and explicit private user-data directory; strict ad-hoc signature verification

cases.change: restored original main name and identifier

asar_hypothesis_check.conclusion: Stale ASAR header alone did not reproduce this helper fatal under the tested package configuration

limits: This identifies the diagnostic clone's helper-loading crash, not every startup failure or the state of the installed application.
The reproduction matched the fatal source line and signal, not a symbolicated instruction offset.
No original installed app or provider task was launched during the controlled probe.
An earlier separate diagnostic launch lacked explicit private user-data-dir; standard-profile effects cannot be attributed or ruled out without a prelaunch snapshot.
